التحقتن (form VIII)
# اِلْتَحَقْتُنَّ (iltaḥaqtunna) /il.ta.ħaq.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِلْتَحَقَ (iltaḥaqa)
# اُلْتُحِقْتُنَّ (ultuḥiqtunna) /ul.tu.ħiq.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِلْتَحَقَ (iltaḥaqa)
